limitations: Scheduling avsync can be zero by construction from future-video scheduling offset; no physical A/V or continuous scanout claim.
Repeated IPC observations are not independent frames. All60 unique exact source frames are covered here, but completion/current-state evidence is not physical presentation.
Native EOF/draining status alone does not determine remaining audio-clock validity. Fixed runs retain25 active-tail steady snapshots each and end with clock invalid, pending0.
Default gapless reaches audio status EOF while queued audio remains active; gapless=no uses draining. Status names are not physical audible-tail measurements.
Steady scheduling uses the existing first2s/user-pause/seek exclusions; all IPC atomic counts are also retained and expose startup invalid-active tuples.
M3 160x96 processing of1080p source at roughly6completedFPS remains Adaptive and does not qualify Live or M5 performance.
Memory/RSS are samples; configured256MiB MLX cache is a soft policy with whole-buffer overshoot, not a hard instantaneous ceiling.

The old continuous clip result is retained as failed EOF timing acceptance. A new full clip run is required before restoring that criterion.
